# Municipal Ordinance No. 09, Series of 2001

**MUn. Ord. No. 09**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 09, Series of [[2001]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on November 26, 2001. This ordinance creates the position of License Inspector I in the Office of the Municipal Treasurer. The position is assigned salary grade 6 in the plantilla of personnel schedule, with corresponding appropriations to be included in the annual budget for fiscal year [[2002]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — The position of License Inspector I is hereby created in the Office of the Municipal Treasurer with salary grade 6 in the plantilla of personnel schedule.
- **Section 2** — Functions, duties, and responsibilities of the License Inspector I:
  1. To keep and maintain all files of municipal business permit licenses according to the municipality.
  2. To update all business permits and license records posted in the corresponding ledger card.
  3. To conduct tax campaign on all delinquent municipal business taxes and licenses.
  4. Upon the instruction of the Municipal Treasurer, inspect all books of accounts of all municipal business in the municipality.
  5. Perform such other functions, duties, and responsibilities as instructed by the Municipal Treasurer.
- **Section 3** — The corresponding appropriations and expenditures for License Inspector I shall be included in the annual budget for the year [[2002]].
- **Section 4** — This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
- **Section 5** — Any ordinance or part thereof which is inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed.
- **Section 6** — Approved by the Sangguniang Bayan of Pitogo, Quezon this 26th day of November, 2001.
